precepts.text: Precept brought by the captain: I brought this people out of bondage, and gave them my commandments by my servants the prophets, whom they would not hear, but despised my counsels. The counsel the prophets bring out of the scriptures is God's counsel; when you resist it, it is not men you are despising. The carnal man causes you to resist the direction God wants you to grow in.
precepts.point: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways: always tossed around, never steady, never going head on.

note.label: Listen, Learn & Live The Art of Enduring in The Truth

precepts.why:
When people come into this faith, the challenge is dealing with the spiritual man as opposed to the carnal man. They pray for wisdom, for discernment, to grow in the truth, and then they will not listen to the men appointed before them, because the carnal man or carnal woman does not see things spiritually. Ezra shows the spirit behind it: “Thus saith the Lord, I brought this people out of bondage, and I gave them my commandments by menservants the prophets; whom they would not hear, but despised my counsels.”

God gave his commandments by the prophets to teach the people, and they would not hear the prophets. But whose counsels did they despise? “my counsels”: God’s. The prophets open the scriptures and show you thus saith the Lord to help you overcome what you are dealing with, and when you resist, it is the counsel God truly gave you that you despise. It came through men, but God inspired it.

So whoever brings correction your way, men or women, it is for your benefit, and they are being inspired by the Lord to direct you according to the path you should walk. Be humble, be quiet and listen. They are coming out of the scriptures and showing your error. Learn; this is how we grow. The carnal man will cause you to resist the direction God wants you to grow in, and that is the wavering, double minded man who shall not receive any thing of the Lord.

All scripture is given by inspiration of God for reproof, correction and instruction in righteousness. It is not a book to tote your ego so you feel good. If the Lord showed us who we are, we would be ashamed; it is only the mercy of Christ and his promise that we are here. For us to change, somebody has to tell us what we were doing wrong, and when they do, don’t get mad.

precepts.text: I brought you up with gladness, but with sorrow and heaviness have I lost you: for ye have sinned before the Lord your God. The gospel is hid to them that are lost, to him that is still in sin and will not renounce the hidden things of dishonesty.
precepts.point: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory. When we behold the glass openly, we change. There is supposed to be a change in us.

note.label: Listen, Learn & Live The Art of Enduring in The Truth

precepts.why:
“But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost”. Who are the lost? Ezra shows it: “I brought you up with gladness; but with sorrow and heaviness have I lost you: for ye have sinned before the Lord your God, and done that thing that is evil before him.”

The gospel is hid to them that are lost: to him that is still in sin and has not renounced the hidden things of dishonesty. Those are the ones that are lost, still in sin, refusing to stop being dishonest and living as a sinner. If you think you found God while you live like that, you are lost. Your religion is vain and you do not really believe.

“But what shall I now do unto you? I am a widow and forsaken: go your way, O my children, and ask mercy of the Lord.”

So beholding the glory of the Lord with an open face must bring a change. Christ showed Peter his errors before he was converted, telling him he would deny him thrice, and afterward Peter was the head of the church. God opens his book and shows us, and sends prophets to show us how to get right. It does not feel good, like medicine, but if you are sincere you take it and get better. If you do not, you remain lost, and you become an example of what not to do.

precepts.text: The heathen shall envy thee, but they shall be able to do nothing against thee, saith the Lord. They cannot stop it, because they are not going to be in rulership any more.
precepts.point: In closing: there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt. That is Esau. The way Esau treated us is going to be to his own detriment.

note.label: The Colossians & The CHRISTIANS of America

precepts.why:
Isaiah said the wicked shall see and be ashamed for their envy at the people. Who are those people? God's chosen people. Ezra says it: “The heathen shall envy thee, but they shall be able to do nothing against thee, saith the Lord.”

The heathen shall envy the Israelites. But they shall be able to do nothing. They can't stop it, because they ain't going to be in rulership any more. They are not going to have ownership any more.

That is the end of the man who ruleth over another to his own hurt: the time of his rule runs out, and all his envy cannot stop what the Lord has spoken for Israel.

precepts.text: In the midst of them there was a young man of a high stature, taller than all the rest, and upon every one of their heads he set crowns. Christ is a young man; he was crucified at 33, so art department, don't make him look old. And taller than all the rest means by feet, not inches. These be they that have put off the mortal clothing, and put on the immortal, and have confessed the name of God; it is the Son of God, whom they have confessed in the world, that crowneth them and giveth them palms.
precepts.point: For it is not a light thing to do wickedly against the laws of God. Sometimes we take the laws of the Most High for granted with the mentality, I can sin and God won't do nothing.

note.label: From Brother To Betrayer

precepts.why:
Who is it that gives out the crowns? Ezra saw it: “And in the midst of them there was a young man of a high stature, taller than all the rest, and upon every one of their heads he set crowns, and was more exalted; which I marvelled at greatly.”

Christ is a young man. He was crucified at 33, so art department, don’t make him look old. And taller than all the rest doesn’t mean by a couple of inches; it means by feet. You are going to know, that’s the Son of God right there, no question.

“So I asked the angel, and said, Sir, what are these? He answered and said unto me, These be they that have put off the mortal clothing, and put on the immortal, and have confessed the name of God: now are they crowned, and receive palms.” This is what we all want.

“Then said I unto the angel, What young person is it that crowneth them, and giveth them palms in their hands? So he answered and said unto me, It is the Son of God, whom they have confessed in the world. Then began I greatly to commend them that stood so stiffly for the name of the Lord.”

The crown comes from Christ, to those who confessed him and stood stiffly for the name of the Lord. It cannot be bought from a king the way Jason bought the priesthood, or cheated for the way a brother cheated the officer of 50 test.

precepts.text: In the midst of them there was a young man of a high stature, taller than all the rest. What young person is it that crowneth them, and giveth them palms in their hands? It is the Son of God. That is why his king shall be higher than Agag.
precepts.point: When he looked on Amalek: that is what you call the Israelis today. Amalek was the first of the nations that fought against us, but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever. The Kenites shall be wasted until Asshur, the Assyrians, carry them away captive; Judges 1:16 tells you about the Kenites. Ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber: write down 1 Maccabees 1:1 and 8:5.

note.label: Religion - The False Prophet

precepts.why:
Balaam, in his trance, saw that Israel’s “king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.” Agag was an Edomite, a real tall one. The kingdom that is going to be exalted is the kingdom of the Lord, and the king higher than Agag is Christ.

Ezra saw that same king: “in the midst of them there was a young man of a high stature, taller than all the rest, and upon every one of their heads he set crowns, and was more exalted”. Ezra asked the angel who these were, and he answered, “These be they that have put off the mortal clothing, and put on the immortal, and have confessed the name of God: now are they crowned, and receive palms.” Then, “What young person is it that crowneth them, and giveth them palms in their hands?” And the answer: “It is the Son of God”.

So that is what Balaam saw in the spirit realm about the Israelites. His king shall be taller even than Agag. There will be no question in the kingdom which one is the Son of God. He is going to be the tallest one, and not by an inch or a foot; it is going to be astronomically clear. You will look and say, that is the Son of God right there.

And Balaam saw more of him: “he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.” Balaam saw Christ destroying the nations. And “Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee”: anybody that blesses Israel shall be blessed, and anybody that curses us shall be cursed.

precepts.text: The number of those sealed in the feast of the Lord who have fulfilled the law, then a great people on mount Zion whom Ezra could not number: Revelation 7:4 and 7:9 explained.
precepts.point: These are they which came out of great tribulation and washed their robes white in the blood of the Lamb: so much for not going through tribulation.

note.label: From Exile & Tribulation to Promise

precepts.why:
Revelation 7:4 gives “an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel”, and then verse 9 gives the great multitude. They say, see, we are all included. Ezra explains it crystal clear.

“Arise up and stand, behold the number of those that be sealed in the feast of the Lord”. That is Revelation 7:4, the 144,000. “Which are departed from the shadow of the world, and have received glorious garments of the Lord”: new bodies. “Take thy number, O Sion, and shut up those of thine that are clothed in white, which have fulfilled the law of the Lord. The number of thy children, whom thou longedst for, is fulfilled”. Verses 38 to 41 are Revelation 7:4.

Now verse 42: “I Esdras saw upon the mount Sion a great people, whom I could not number, and they all praised the Lord with songs.” That is Revelation 7:9. The great multitude is Zion, mount Zion.

So the 144,000 are the men, the Israelite leaders of the twelve tribes; the great multitude are more men, women and children of Israel. And “these are they which came out of great tribulation”: so much for the church teaching that we don’t have to go through tribulation.

precepts.text: For thy help will I send my servants Esaias and Jeremy.
precepts.point: I will give power unto my two witnesses. Before every judgment God sends two prophets: Isaiah and Jeremiah, Joshua and Zerubbabel, Moses and Elijah.

note.label: Judgement - the Testimony of the Two Witnesses

precepts.why:
“For thy help will I send my servants”: God says he is going to send Isaiah and Jeremiah. And that is what happened. Isaiah and Jeremiah came and prophesied before Babylon came and destroyed Jerusalem.

That is the pattern behind “I will give power unto my two witnesses.” God always sends forth witnesses before he brings forth judgment, and he sends them in twos. Isaiah and Jeremiah before Babylon; Joshua and Zerubbabel in Zechariah’s day; Moses and Elijah in Revelation 11. Christ sent the apostles and the seventy out in twos for the same reason: you need two witnesses to bring forth judgment.

So the two witnesses of Revelation 11 are the two major prophets that come before the end, and they also speak of Israel as a whole, the people God calls his witnesses on this earth. Judgment does not fall until the witnesses have prophesied.

precepts.text: A great people whom none could number stood on mount Sion, and one taller than all the rest set crowns upon every one of their heads.
precepts.point: Israel once had mighty kings who ruled over countries beyond the river, and tribute and custom were paid unto them. The kings failed when they forsook the law, and their power was given to a strange nation; that is why the kings of the scriptures are not known as black kings today. When the King of kings returns He restores the crowns, and He sets crowns on the heads of the great multitude on mount Sion.

note.label: Genesis 35: Bethel and the Twelve Sons of Israel

precepts.why:
“I Esdras saw upon the mount Sion a great people, whom I could not number, and they all praised the Lord with songs. And in the midst of them there was a young man of a high stature, taller than all the rest, and upon every one of their heads he set crowns”.

That is where the promise “kings shall come out of thy loins” ends up. The kings of Israel lost their power when they forsook the law, but when the King of kings returns He restores the crowns: He sets crowns on the heads of the great multitude on mount Sion. The men of Israel are kings in the sight of the Most High, and Christ crowns them.

precepts.text: The sealed that departed from the shadow of the world receive glorious garments of the Lord.
precepts.point: The sealed of the Lord receive the same. The hundred forty and four thousand of Revelation 7 that must be sealed before destruction comes are read of again in 2 Esdras: they departed from the shadow of the world, leaving spiritual Egypt and the ways Babylon taught behind, and have received glorious garments of the Lord. In the kingdom of heaven the Most High will clothe His men in glorious garments as in ancient times, on another level than anything worn today.

note.label: Exodus 28: Holy Garments for Glory and for Beauty

precepts.why:
The sealed of the Lord receive the same. “Arise up and stand, behold the number of those that be sealed in the feast of the Lord; Which are departed from the shadow of the world, and have received glorious garments of the Lord.”

Those that be sealed departed from the shadow of the world, leaving spiritual Egypt and the ways Babylon taught behind, and have received glorious garments of the Lord. As Aaron was given holy garments for glory and for beauty, in the kingdom of heaven the Most High will clothe His men in glorious garments as in ancient times, on another level than anything worn today.

precepts.point: When Paul says he conferred not with flesh and blood, he means no man taught him the doctrine or the gospel; Christ revealed it directly.

note.label: Galatians 1: Paul's Apostleship and the True Gospel

precepts.why:
“that I might preach him among the heathen” refers to Israel. Ezra called Israel heathens: “I Esdras received a charge of the Lord upon the mount Oreb, that I should go unto Israel; but when I came unto them, they set me at nought, and despised the commandment of the Lord.” He was sent to Israel, and it is Israel he then addresses as the heathen, because when you do not keep the laws you follow after the other nations.

So Paul was a minister unto the heathen, meaning the Israelites that were following the customs of other nations.

precepts.point: That is why Christ is called the end of the law (of sacrifice) to them that believe. Ephesians 2:14-16 shows Christ broke down the middle wall of partition between the two kingdoms, abolishing in his flesh the enmity (the law of commandments contained in ordinances, meaning the sacrificial laws), making of twain one new man.

note.label: Galatians 2: The Council at Jerusalem and Justification by Faith

precepts.why:
“Take thy number, O Sion, and shut up those of thine that are clothed in white, which have fulfilled the law of the Lord.”

The ones counted to Sion are those clothed in white who have fulfilled the law of the Lord, not those who were compelled to circumcision and animal sacrifice by the false brethren. The liberty we have in Christ Jesus is what makes room for all of Sion's number, including the northern kingdom that the old covenant of sacrifice had shut out.

precepts.point: They are called brethren of the Gentiles. Romans 9:3-4 proves the apostles' brethren are Israelites.

note.label: Galatians 2: The Council at Jerusalem and Justification by Faith

precepts.why:
Ezra calls Israel heathen outright. “I Esdras received a charge of the Lord upon the mount Oreb, that I should go unto Israel; but when I came unto them, they set me at nought, and despised the commandment of the Lord. And therefore I say unto you, O ye heathen, that hear and understand, look for your Shepherd, he shall give you everlasting rest; for he is nigh at hand, that shall come in the end of the world.”

He was sent to Israel, and because they set the commandments of God at naught he calls them “ye heathen.” The Shepherd they are told to look for is Christ. So “that we should go unto the heathen” is Paul going to Israelites who had set the commandments at naught.

note.label: Flawed Apologetic Doctrine

precepts.why:
Is there a scripture that says the gospel is hid to the lost because of sin? “I brought you up with gladness; but with sorrow and heaviness have I lost you: for ye have sinned before the Lord your God, and done that thing that is evil before him.” The gospel is hid to them that have sinned. That is why they don’t understand it: they are lost.

If you break the commandments and teach men so, you shall be called least in the kingdom of heaven. You have done evil before God and handled the word of God deceitfully. You told the people Christ died for everyone, and he said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel. But God so loved the world? You are lost. You do not have a good understanding of what it means, because you are not keeping the commandments.

note.label: Flawed Apologetic Doctrine

precepts.why: There happens to be a scripture in the Bible that explains it: “I Esdras saw upon the mount Sion a great people, whom I could not number, and they all praised the Lord with songs.” Ezra saw the same thing John saw: a great people he could not number, all praising the Lord.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 20

precepts.why: “Wheresoever thou findest the dead, take them and bury them, and I will give thee the first place in my resurrection.”

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 7 Sealing The 144k

precepts.why: The prophet Esdras saw a similar vision. “Behold the number of those that be sealed”: that’s the 144. “Take thy number, O Sion, and shut up those of thine that are clothed in white, which have fulfilled the law of the Lord”: seal them with what? It tells you right there, which have fulfilled the law of the Lord. “May be hallowed”: made holy.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 7 Sealing The 144k

precepts.why: Verse 42 explains Revelation 7:9. “I Esdras saw upon the mount Sion a great people, whom I could not number”: mount Sion is another name for the Israelites.

note.label: DELIVERANCE: The Chain Of Events

precepts.why: “And those that be dead will I raise up again from their places, and bring them out of the graves: for I have known my name in Israel.” The Lord already prophesied it: I’m going to raise them up. So the Israelites that die, don’t worry about that; he’s going to raise them up. The dead are going to rise first.

note.label: The Purpose of God's Wrath and Mercy

precepts.why: “Go, and ye shall receive: pray for few days unto you, that they may be shortened: the kingdom is already prepared for you: watch.” Brothers and sisters, the kingdom’s already prepared; it’s already done.

note.label: FOT 2025 OPENING: THE EARTHLY AND HEAVENLY TABERNACLES

precepts.why:
“I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.” It is one of the favorite scriptures, and Christ said the same: ye are gods.

The everlasting tabernacles are given to the gods, the children of the Most High.

note.label: FOT 2025 OPENING: THE EARTHLY AND HEAVENLY TABERNACLES

precepts.why:
“The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Judah.” The Lord saves the tents of Judah first.

“In that day shall the Lord defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David”: mighty and powerful. “And the house of David shall be as God, as the angel of the Lord before them.” They shall be as God. They are going to be as he is.

That is what John said in 1 John 3: we shall be as he is. And we shall be as he is with everlasting tabernacles. The glory God takes unto himself and the tabernacles he gives in 2 Esdras 2:11 make the house of David as God.

note.label: FOT 2025 OPENING: THE EARTHLY AND HEAVENLY TABERNACLES

precepts.why:
If we will be as gods, then what is the Lord? What is his title? “For the Lord your God is God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, a mighty, and a terrible, which regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward”.

He is the God of the gods. We are the gods; he is the God of gods. We are the lords; he is the Lord of lords. His title proves what Israel shall be when we are given the everlasting tabernacles.

note.label: FOT 2025 OPENING: THE EARTHLY AND HEAVENLY TABERNACLES

precepts.why:
“And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father”. Us, Israel: he made us kings, and he made us priests.

Unto God and his Father. Christ is our God, and he has his God: our God has a God, and he answers to the one true God, his Father.

“To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.” If he made us kings and priests, then what is he? The King over the kings.

note.label: FOT 2025 OPENING: THE EARTHLY AND HEAVENLY TABERNACLES

precepts.why:
“And he hath on his vesture and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.” He is the God of the gods, and here is where the gods are: he is a King, and we are the kings; he is the Lord, and we are the lords.

When it says thigh it is referring to his pants. He did not have on Cam Newton shorts with a damn tattoo on his thigh. The Christians say these things and believe it; they are out of their minds.

God of gods, King of kings, Lord of lords: the everlasting tabernacles make Israel the gods, the kings and the lords he is over.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 14 Part 1

precepts.why: “Behold the number of those that be sealed in the feast of the Lord”: that’s the 144,000 of Revelation 7:4. “Which are departed from the shadow of the world”: which is sin. “Take thy number, O Sion”: it is telling you who they are; Sion is another name for Israelites. “Which have fulfilled the law of the Lord”: when you see Israelites not keeping the law, if they cannot apply basic law, love your neighbour as yourself, get away from them. “The number of thy children, whom thou longedst for, is fulfilled”: Christ said when this gospel shall be preached in all the world, then shall the end come. You think everybody has to hear it; it ain’t talking about that. When the 144,000 is reached, that’s it. When the last one is sealed, then destruction comes.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 14 Part 1

precepts.why: “I Esdras saw upon the mount Sion a great people, whom I could not number”: this is saying the same thing as Revelation 7:9. “And in the midst of them there was a young man of a high stature, taller than all the rest”: it calls him a young man because he died in his early thirties, and he is going to come back with that same body. “It is the Son of God, whom they have confessed in the world.” “Them that stood so stiffly for the name of the Lord”: the name of the Lord refers to his law and his testimony.

note.label: THE REWARD OF THE RIGHTEOUS: WHO IS REALLY GETTING IN?

precepts.why:
“And therefore I say unto you, O ye heathen, that hear and understand, look for your Shepherd, he shall give you everlasting rest”. Who are the heathen? Verse 7: “Let them be scattered abroad among the heathen”. We were scattered; that is why we are called heathen. He is not giving everlasting rest to the people who put us in slavery.

“Be ready to the reward of the kingdom, for the everlasting light shall shine upon you for evermore.” He is talking to the Israelites. “Flee the shadow of this world”; receive the gift and give thanks to him “that hath led you to the heavenly kingdom”, as we read in Ephesians 1. “Take thy number, O Sion, and shut up those of thine that are clothed in white, which have fulfilled the law of the Lord.” Clothed in white: the filthy garments taken off, as read earlier, by keeping the commandments of God. “Thy people, which have been called from the beginning”.

“I Esdras saw upon the mount Sion a great people, whom I could not number, and they all praised the Lord with songs”, and a young man “taller than all the rest” set crowns on their heads. “These be they that have put off the mortal clothing, and put on the immortal, and have confessed the name of God”. Through all the destruction we repented, and it was only for us to repent, northern and southern kingdom, Israel as a whole. We confess the name of God by keeping his commandments, doing the work and going out and teaching our people.

“It is the Son of God, whom they have confessed in the world. Then began I greatly to commend them that stood so stiffly for the name of the Lord.” Christ is crowning those people.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 19 Supper, War & Marriage

precepts.why: “Be ready to the reward of the kingdom, for the everlasting light shall shine upon you for evermore.”

note.label: The Evolution of Persecution

precepts.why:
If it were false, they wouldn’t worry about it. Santa Claus is false, and nobody does anything to Santa Claus: you let him come to your chimney and give him cookies and milk. But say you have to keep the commandments and that you’re an Israelite, and oh no, he has to go.

“It is the Son of God, whom they have confessed in the world. Then began I greatly to commend them that stood so stiffly for the name of the Lord.” You must know the scriptures, the commandments, to stand stiffly, because things are going to get tough in these last days. If you don’t believe, you are going to walk out the door. In 2018 it was easy, cut and dry, and still a lot of people left. What is going to happen when Esau runs an ABC special saying IUIC is a hate group? Are you going to run out the door?

note.label: Must Be Hated To Be Heard! The Price Of Speaking Truth To Modern Day Christians

precepts.why: The palms are seldom explained. “Of the tribe of Juda were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben were sealed twelve thousand”, and so through all the tribes of Israel to Benjamin. “After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands; And cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God which sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.” Those are the same palms given to us in 2 Esdras 2:45.

note.label: Must Be Hated To Be Heard! The Price Of Speaking Truth To Modern Day Christians

precepts.why: “Flee the shadow of this world, receive the joyfulness of your glory: I testify my Saviour openly. O receive the gift that is given you.” The ones crowned and given palms are the ones who received this gift.

note.label: Must Be Hated To Be Heard! The Price Of Speaking Truth To Modern Day Christians

precepts.why: “Flee the shadow of this world, receive the joyfulness of your glory: I testify my Saviour openly. O receive the gift that is given you.” The ones crowned and given palms are the ones who received this gift.

note.label: Must Be Hated To Be Heard! The Price Of Speaking Truth To Modern Day Christians

precepts.why: What is the gift given us? “For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life.” The gift of God is eternal life.

note.label: Must Be Hated To Be Heard! The Price Of Speaking Truth To Modern Day Christians

precepts.why: Some will die. But if they die, what then? “And those that be dead will I raise up again from their places, and bring them out of the graves: for I have known my name in Israel.” That is what we have to believe: for teaching this word we are going to be hated, and they are going to come against us and kill us. But that is the only way this gospel will get heard, by us forcing this word down people’s throats to hear it.

But that is the only way this gospel will get heard, by us forcing this word down people’s throats to hear it.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 14 Part 2

precepts.why:
“Behold the number of those that be sealed in the feast of the Lord”: the number of those sealed is 144,000. Ezra is saying the same thing John the Revelator was saying. “Which are departed from the shadow of the world”: departed from sin. “And have received glorious garments of the Lord”: the white robes.

“Take thy number, O Sion”: Sion is another name for Israel. “And shut up those of thine that are clothed in white, which have fulfilled the law of the Lord.” That verifies what the sealing is: it ain’t saying fulfill the hexagram, it ain’t saying fulfill your sexual desire; fulfill the law of the Lord. Study, pray, apply.

“The number of thy children, whom thou longedst for, is fulfilled”: that is the 144. “That thy people, which have been called from the beginning, may be hallowed”: called from the beginning of time, when we were with the Lord in the heavens and he said you will be chosen as my elect, and this group over here will play the devil on earth. We came down into these fleshly bodies, and we are just fulfilling our roles.

“I Esdras saw upon the mount Sion a great people, whom I could not number”: this is Revelation 7:9, and it says on mount Sion, that is Israel. “And they all praised the Lord with songs.”

note.label: Escape New Years | Armageddon: Chain Of Events

precepts.why:
Guess who is here today helping raise up the tribes of Israel: Jeremy is here. “And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee.” In Jeremiah’s time, did he discontinue from God’s heritage? Did he forget he was an Israelite? No. So this is talking about when he comes back on the earth again: he forgot who he was, caught up in Christianity and Muslim.

“And I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not.” Did Jeremiah ever serve his enemies when he was alive? No, he wasn’t a slave. When he comes back he will serve his enemy in the land he knew not, and that land is America. Jeremiah was a slave here in America, serving his enemies for food, working a 9 to 5. “For ye have kindled a fire in mine anger, which shall burn for ever.”

He served wood and stone: the wood is Christianity, the stone is Islam, they worship a rock. But Jeremiah is here today, and the Lord is going to put his spirit on him, and he will be a leader helping Zion raise up her children in the last days.

note.label: Escape New Years | Armageddon: Chain Of Events

precepts.why:
Isaiah is here in the last days helping wake Israel up. “And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the Lord.” Then God is talking to Isaiah: “My spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed’s seed, saith the Lord, from henceforth and for ever.”

Isaiah’s lineage are all prophets, because Isaiah always comes back to his line. His seed is still here on the earth, and when Isaiah comes on the earth he is going to be a prophet again; God says, my word is not going to depart out of your mouth. Isaiah will always be a prophet, and he keeps coming back to his lineage.

That’s why in 2 Esdras 2:18 the Lord says, I will send you Isaiah to help you. He is going to help raise up the tribes of Israel, help Zion raise up her children; he has an important role to play in raising up the children of Israel in the last days.

note.label: Escape New Years | Armageddon: Chain Of Events

precepts.why:
“Let us now praise famous men, and our fathers that begat us.” “Such as did bear rule in their kingdoms, men renowned for their power, giving counsel by their understanding, and declaring prophecies: Leaders of the people by their counsels, and by their knowledge of learning meet for the people, wise and eloquent are their instructions”: that’s Isaiah.

“But these were merciful men, whose righteousness hath not been forgotten. With their seed shall continually remain a good inheritance, and their children are within the covenant.” “Their seed standeth fast, and their children for their sakes”: their children are always going to be prophets because their father was a prophet. Their seed stands fast; they ain’t gone off, they are going to find this truth at some point in time, always.

“Their seed shall remain for ever”: as Isaiah 59:21 says, from henceforth even for ever, “and their glory shall not be blotted out.” The Lord says that because the people he sends through their seed is the elect: he sends righteous men through their seed.

note.label: Escape New Years | Armageddon: Chain Of Events

precepts.why:
This is talking about Isaiah, but it also goes into Christ in the end. “The Lord hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name. And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me; And said unto me, Thou art my servant, O Israel, in whom I will be glorified.”

“Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for nought, and in vain: yet surely my judgment is with the Lord, and my work with my God”: the work that you do on the earth, the Lord sees.

“And now, saith the Lord that formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob again to him”: Isaiah was formed to be God’s servant, to bring Jacob again to him. Isaiah has a serious role to play. These are the jobs of the prophets, to keep bringing Jacob back to the Lord through the scriptures. So go back to 2 Esdras 2:18, “For thy help will I send my servants”: my servant Isaiah is that same servant mentioned in Isaiah 49.

note.label: Escape New Years | Armageddon: Chain Of Events

precepts.why:
When the Lord was dealing with the two types of servants: “For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me. Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?”

These men were doing it naturally. They know when a brother is sick to go see him, when a brother is hungry to feed him, when a brother is naked to clothe him. The wicked seem confused, but to the righteous it’s a natural thing. You are going to know who you are by your works. “Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.”

You will know your role, your lot, what to do; you don’t need the Lord to guide you that way, because this is your job. That’s why he says, I will send you my servants Isaiah and Jeremiah: these men are going to set us in the right order we’re supposed to be in and tell us what to do. Brother, you need to visit brothers in jail, write these brothers in jail, be in their community and fix their community, be in the hospital visiting the brothers that get sick or get shot. That’s going to be natural to the righteous man; the simple man and the wicked man are not going to do none of that.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 3 A Message to The 7 Churches

precepts.why: “Arise up and stand, behold the number of those that be sealed in the feast of the Lord; Which are departed from the shadow of the world, and have received glorious garments of the Lord.” See that: have received glorious garments of the Lord. That is twofold right there: those glorious garments are both literal and spiritual. So wherever this church is today in Israel, there are a few members who have not been defiled, but the rest of you better examine yourselves.

note.label: War With The Beast: Death & Persecution

precepts.why:
“A great multitude, which no man could number”: the same great people we just read in 2 Esdras, the people upon mount Sion, the twelve tribes of Israel. They are “of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues”: that is Zion that was scattered into all nations, peoples and tongues. That is how easy it is.

They “stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands”: they got that crown; they have put on the immortal and taken off the mortal. And they cried, “Salvation to our God”: our God, which is possessive.

note.label: War With The Beast: Death & Persecution

precepts.why:
Somebody else asked the same question as Ezra: “What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?” And the answer: “These are they which came out of great tribulation”. Those are the twelve tribes that were persecuted by the beast.

That great tribulation is persecution, Jacob’s trouble, being persecuted for the word of God. Endure it, and you will get that crown.

With those tabernacles we shall be as gods. That is why the scriptures call Israel gods, kings and lords, and call the Most High the God of gods, the King of kings and the Lord of lords. We shall be as he is, with everlasting tabernacles.

note.label: Living Martyrs

points: “And in the midst of them there was a young man of a high stature, taller than all the rest”: a young man who is very tall, taller than all of the Israelites, “and upon every one of their heads he set crowns, and was more exalted.”

note.label: Living Martyrs

points: “These be they that have put off the mortal clothing, and put on the immortal”: that is where we started at the beginning, 1 Corinthians 15, saying the same thing. “And have confessed the name of God: now are they crowned, and receive palms.”

note.label: Living Martyrs

points: “What young person is it that crowneth them, and giveth them palms in their hands?” “It is the Son of God.” Remember Christ was crucified around the age of 33. He is young-looking in the face. Stop showing him as an old man with no teeth.
“Whom they have confessed in the world”: that is Matthew 10, whosoever shall confess me before men. “Then began I greatly to commend them that stood so stiffly for the name of the Lord.”

So don’t be afraid of dying; be afraid of dying in wickedness. Everybody is going to die, whether at 120 or right now during the persecution, and if you make it to 120 and die in wickedness, you are finished, no matter how much fun you had on the earth. Things are going to get very bad, but you cannot give up. If you give up on your spouse in this truth, or somebody offends you and you leave, that is not standing stiffly for the word of God. Ezra commended them because they stood stiffly and did not give up. Ask yourself: are you molding yourself to be that brother, that sister, or just wasting space?

note.label: Living Martyrs

points: “These be they that have put off the mortal clothing, and put on the immortal, and have confessed the name of God: now are they crowned, and receive palms.”
The palm is a sign of victory, of achievement. That is what we all want: to say we got that crown, we got that palm, we were clothed in white, we stood stiffly for the name of God.

note.label: Must Be Hated To Be Heard! The Price Of Speaking Truth To Modern Day Christians

points: “What young person is it that crowneth them, and giveth them palms in their hands? So he answered and said unto me, It is the Son of God, whom they have confessed in the world. Then began I greatly to commend them that stood so stiffly for the name of the Lord.” What Ezra was seeing was us in the last days, what we went through. These are the men who stood stiffly in the face of being put to death and imprisoned. They did not give up and did not hold their tongues; they spoke the word. That is why, brothers, stay in the scriptures as it is written: he that leads into captivity shall go into captivity.

note.label: Must Be Hated To Be Heard! The Price Of Speaking Truth To Modern Day Christians

note.label: Escape New Years | Armageddon: Chain Of Events

points: “For thy help will I send my servants”: in order to raise up them children, God says, I’m going to send you help, Zion. The first one named is Isaiah, then Jeremy, who is Jeremiah. Isaiah is called my servant, that same servant mentioned in Isaiah 49, formed to raise up the tribes of Israel. Isaiah is here today and Jeremy is here today, helping raise up the tribes of Israel. Those two brothers, I think they are the two witnesses: God is going to send these two men in the last days.

“After whose counsel I have sanctified”: whatever they teach, God sanctifies; these men are not going to teach dumb, stupid doctrine. “And prepared for thee twelve trees laden with divers fruits”: the twelve trees are the 12 apostles. Isaiah and Jeremy are great men, but they are not the 12 apostles; they are going to help the 12 apostles. The fruits are brothers and sisters waking up in the hundreds and the thousands, the saints waking up. This is not talking about one man, two men or three men; it is a lot of mighty men.

The apostles’ job is to teach this word and wake Israel up throughout the four corners of the earth, to bring forth fruit. Some people say numbers don’t matter. If in your teachings nobody is repenting, nobody is changing, nobody wants to follow you, examine your spirit. Numbers are not a sign of all being righteous: not everybody in IUIC is righteous, some of you are wicked as hell, some of you changed and some will never change. Numbers are a sign of progress, a sign the word is being spread successfully, the fruits of the labor being performed. We don’t boast in the thousands, because the larger the numbers, the larger the problems. And if numbers didn’t matter we wouldn’t read that 3,000 repented in a day, or 5,000 believed; it shows the disciples were putting in work and were successful. Even some of them that changed weren’t right, like the brother and sister that were lying, and the Holy Spirit killed them.

A visionary brother looks across and says, I want to build a bridge to go over there; the simple brother says the hell with these brothers on the other side. If you are a leader comfortable with one fruit, two fruits, the 10 or 15 brothers you got, you ain’t the guys: you’re here to gather the 12 tribes of the house of Israel, so get up on your simple behind and do the work. It started with 10 brothers in a room, it started with three, and it grew and grew. We got thousands of teachers, officers teaching daily bread every day, classes every hour seven days of the week; it’s not a one man thing. Whoever comes after us will get more numbers, because we’re going to set them up in the right sanctuary to do the job: these are prophets that came back to do the same job.

Numbers mean the word is going out and it’s almost time for us to go home. The sooner the elect is sealed the better, and we’re going to be up out of here. We do what we do because we want our reward, immortality, the kingdom of heaven, and the Most High is not going to forget the labor of love.

note.label: Escape New Years | Armageddon: Chain Of Events

points: “And as many fountains flowing with milk and honey”: brothers with a high level of wisdom and understanding. “And seven mighty mountains”: great prophets that you read about in the Bible. God said they are going to be back, putting in work to raise Israel up, to restore the decayed state of Israel. “Whereupon there grow roses and lilies”: more saints rising up. “Whereby I will fill thy children with joy”: the teachers teaching and the children being fed, the leaders doing the work and the people being filled with joy when they hear you are an Israelite.

note.label: Escape New Years | Armageddon: Chain Of Events

points: “Do right to the widow, judge for the fatherless, give to the poor, defend the orphan, clothe the naked”: have charity. These are the things you got to do as a leader. “Heal the broken and the weak”: we all are broken, that’s why we here. “Laugh not a lame man to scorn.” “And let the blind man come into the sight of my clearness”: teach the gospel and wake people up to this truth.

note.label: Escape New Years | Armageddon: Chain Of Events

points: “And I will give thee the first place in my resurrection”: if you do these things you are going to be a great leader in his resurrection, one of the 144.

note.label: Escape New Years | Armageddon: Chain Of Events

points: “Nourish thy children, O thou good nurse”: nourish them in the laws of God; that’s what nourishes us.

note.label: Escape New Years | Armageddon: Chain Of Events

points: “As for the servants whom I have given thee, there shall not one of them perish.” Everything just read, the trees with the fruits, the fountains, the mountains, Isaiah, Jeremiah, all of that is God’s servants, sent forth to help build Israel back up. We are servants of God. Jeremiah would serve wood and stone, but is Jeremiah going to perish? Is Isaiah? No. If it were possible they would deceive the very elect, but they can’t. He that is righteous, let him be righteous still; him that is wicked, let him be wicked still.

A servant of God ain’t going to be teaching ‘we could pay for prostitutes’, or running around with some bugged out doctrine, because his counsel is sanctified by God. The Holy Spirit is going to open his eyes to see the right thing, to fix it and correct it.

How do you know who they are today? You don’t. He that endures to the end, keeps the commandments to the end: that’s how you’re going to know if you’re one of the servants. All the great men we read, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Malachi, you ain’t going to know who they are today; they’re going to come, do the work and endure to the end, and you’ll say, damn, that brother did a lot of work. Sometimes brothers are in this 10 years, 20 years, then go off down the line and never recover; that means you were not one of the servants.

note.label: Escape New Years | Armageddon: Chain Of Events

points: This is the end of everything, the end of the persecution and affliction. “I Esdras saw upon the mount Sion a great people, whom I could not number, and they all praised the Lord with songs.” That great people is us, delivered, having overcome the beast.

note.label: War With The Beast: Death & Persecution

note.label: War With The Beast: Death & Persecution

points: “These be they that have put off the mortal clothing, and put on the immortal”: they do not have mortal, fleshly bodies any more; they have immortal bodies. “And have confessed the name of God”: they were on the earth teaching the gospel. “Now are they crowned, and receive palms.”

note.label: War With The Beast: Death & Persecution

points: “It is the Son of God, whom they have confessed in the world.” You have to confess the Son of God in affliction. It is not speaking of going on the street now while everything is good and somebody might speak loud at you. It is speaking of the heathen raging and the people imagining a vain thing: calling us a hate group, lying that we are violent, that we hate and abuse women. They told that brother in France he could stay if he stopped teaching the gospel, and he said no. That is keeping God’s testimony in affliction.
“Then began I greatly to commend them that stood so stiffly for the name of the Lord.” The key is standing stiffly, unmovable. Nothing should move you when it comes to the word of God.
